secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key for AI chat responses. Get it from https://console.groq.com/keys. Optional for booting; required for AI chat to work (unless keys are set via the admin panel in Firestore).

secrets.name: COHERE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Cohere API key for AI chat responses. Get it from https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys. Optional.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram Bot token for the Telegram bot integration. Get it from @BotFather on Telegram. Optional; a default token is hardcoded in the code.

secrets.name: APP_URL
secrets.description: The public URL where this app is hosted. Used for self-referential links and Telegram bot. Auto-injected by the platform.
